attributes.text: Alerts for zero-days, Critical and High stories. Quiet from 10pm to 7am unless it's urgent; the night's news comes in one alert at 7am.
Alerts not connected. Alerts need a real phone, not an emulator.
You get world news plus local news, tips and scam reporting links for your country.
A 30 second game after some scam and safety stories. At most 3 a day, never the same one twice.
A short sound with the logo when the app opens. Always silent when your phone is on silent.
